title: fix(app-shell): show the server's reasons under a refused package publish (objectui#13160)
body:
Fixes #13160

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The package sheet's **Publish** (`PackageDetailSheet`'s `publish` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`) now shows the reasons the server returned, under the existing count sentence.

`POST /packages/:id/publish` refuses on a 200: the dispatcher's `{ success: true, data }` envelope around the door's `PackagePublishResult`, whose own `success` is false and whose `validationErrors` carry one `message` per reason, each against the item (`type`, `name`) it judged. The sheet threw only `engine.packages.detail.publishBlocked` with the count, so the author read "Publish blocked by 1 validation error(s)." and never why (the card's measurement: a package with no items, refused with "No metadata items found for package …").

- The count sentence stays as the heading. Each `validationErrors[].message` is a list line under it, in the server's words, led by the item it names when the server names one (`object/lead: …`; `api: …` where the producer names only the type; the bare message where it names neither). Nothing restates the protocol's rule.
- The answer is typed with the spec's `PackagePublishResult` (`@objectstack/spec/system`) instead of `any`.
- `success: false` with an empty `validationErrors` still says `engine.packages.detail.nothingToPublish`. The old fallback there read `validationErrors[0].message` only when the list was empty, so it could never fire; it is gone.
- The message block (`msg`) carries an optional `details` list; only this refusal sets it. Every other action on the sheet renders exactly as before.
- No i18n key is added or changed; no export, prop or accept set moves.

## Mechanism readings (the dispatch's H1 to H4)

- **H1, the shape: confirmed, measured on objectstack `origin/main` `46bb5e3e5`.** The route (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, the `POST /packages/:id/publish` branch) answers `deps.success(result)` with `MetadataManager.publishPackage`'s result. Its two refusals both carry a non-empty `validationErrors` of `{ type, name, message }` (`PackagePublishResultSchema` in `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-persistence.zod.ts`): no items (`type` and `name` both empty), and the gate or validation failures (the namespace gate leaves `name` empty with `type: 'api'`). No other field or path is in the shape.
- **H2, many errors: no cap.** `SheetContent` is `overflow-y-auto`, so a long list extends the sheet's scroll height, as the uncapped pending-drafts list on the same sheet already does; `break-words` keeps a long item id inside the sheet's width. NOT MEASURED in a browser: the reading is the sheet's own class list, not a rendered layout.
- **H3, controls: pinned.** A published package keeps `engine.packages.detail.published`; an empty `validationErrors` keeps `nothingToPublish`; a request that throws (`TypeError: Failed to fetch`) shows its own message. None of the three renders a list.
- **H4, ablation: red with the fix reverted** (below).

## Tests

New: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.publishRefusalReasons-13160.test.tsx` (real sheet and `apiJson`; `fetch` stubbed). Two refusal cases (one item-less reason; two reasons, one with `type/name`, one with `type` only) and the three H3 controls.

Ablation, after committing the fix (`bedd292`): `PackagesPage.tsx` written back to the base blob (`98ee995`, `PackagePublishRefusal` count 0, the old count-only branch count 1), new file run, then restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and checked by blob hash (`431a3fa` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty):

```text
× one reason that names no item: the measured refusal of a package with no items
× two reasons: each is a line, led by the item it names, in the order the server sent them
AssertionError: expected [] to deeply equal [ Array(1) ]   (the heading rendered, no lines under it)
Tests  2 failed | 3 passed (5)
```

The three controls stay green on both sides, as they should.

## Local gates, on head `5178919`

Each exit code captured to a file before any pipe; the heavy three ran under the shared verify lock after the final commit.

| Command | Exit | Its own verdict line |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`, which includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`) | 0 | no `error TS` |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint` | 0 | `0 errors` (warnings are the package's existing ones) |
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage` | 0 | `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 81 passed (81)` |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)` |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | `check-control-bytes: OK` |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 | `No pending changeset names a file this change touches.` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | `2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | 0 | `Every major is the synchronized one` |
| `pnpm check:i18n-keys` | 0 | every in-scope call-site key resolves (run although no i18n text changed; `check:i18n-drift` not run, no string-table row moved) |

The dependency closure was built first (`pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`, exit 0), so the type-check read current `dist/*.d.ts`.

Declared to CI: the full `pnpm test` shards, `Build & E2E`, and every other workflow family.

## Acceptance notes

- `/publish-drafts` (`publishDrafts`, the other door on this sheet) was read for the same defect and does not have it: since objectui#11922 it names each refused item with its reason through `refusedItemsText`, and its empty-`failed[]` refusal reads the envelope's own text. No finding.
- "Adopt loose items" is not touched: the card leaves that half unfiled and unverified.
- objectui#13157 (queued, same file) is not folded, per the claim.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
